patches.name: pc-layout
patches.reason: AppUtils.IsPCLayout: select PC layout without changing platform/network identity.

patches.name: pc-ui
patches.reason: UIUtils.IsPCMode: enable PC UI path without spoofing the operating system.

patches.name: cursor-show-mobile-gate
patches.reason: MouseInputController.ShowCursor: allow its existing PC cursor path on mobile without changing global platform identity.

patches.name: cursor-hide-mobile-gate
patches.reason: MouseInputController.HideCursor: allow the PC cursor hide/lock path instead of returning for a mobile platform.

patches.name: cursor-mode-mobile-gate
patches.reason: MouseInputController.UseCursorMode: read the actual cursor-mode state instead of returning false on mobile.

patches.name: menu-force-cursor-mobile-gate
patches.reason: MouseInputController.ForceShowCursor: allow menu cursor visibility/unlock on mobile while preserving its normal PC/gamepad checks.

patches.name: sdk-force-cursor-mobile-gate
patches.reason: MouseInputController.ForceShowCursorBySDKUI: allow modal UI cursor visibility/unlock on mobile without changing global platform identity.

patches.name: ui-mouse-input-enabled
patches.reason: InControlInputModule.Process: mouse processing must not be gated by the touch-only enable flag.

patches.name: ui-mouse-processing
patches.reason: InControlInputModule.Process: call existing ProcessMouseEvent instead of ProcessTouchEvents; enables native pointer hover, buttons and scroll on the active UI module.

validation.keyboard_mouse: User confirmed keyboard movement, native capture, mouse look and menu cursor visibility. UI mouse processing responds; broader button testing remains pending.
validation.trackpad: Experimental: camera zoom and menu scrolling work. The first UI scale correction missed the wrapper frame; corrected wrapper-aware normalization awaits physical speed testing.
